question: Why did the p95 latency go up on 19 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: The deployment of a new version of the checkout service (v2.26) likely caused the increase in p95 latency.
why_chain: The deployment of checkout v2.26 occurred 2 minutes before the change point.
The change in p95 latency was concentrated in the checkout service.
The deployment of a new version of the service is a known cause of performance changes.

contributing_factors.description: The change in the checkout database pool size (from 50 to 5) may have contributed to the increased latency.
why_chain: The change in db.pool_size occurred 1 minute before the change point.
The change in p95 latency was concentrated in the checkout service.
Changes in database configurations can affect performance.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in request volume caused the p95 latency to rise.
ruled_out.reason: The request volume for checkout did not change significantly (12% increase).

ruled_out.hypothesis: The alerts and logs were unrelated to the change in p95 latency.
ruled_out.reason: The alerts and logs were recorded after the change point and do not explain the increase in p95 latency.

evidence.summary: P95 latency for service checkout rose from 220 ms to 601 ms (+173%), with a change point at 2026-03-19T15:15:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service checkout: 3 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.02).
At the same time, request volume for service checkout stayed about the same (852 per 5 min before, 958 per 5 min after, +12%).
At the same time, error rate for service checkout rose (0.43% before, 0.67% after, +55%).
Deployed checkout v2.26 to us-east (checkout, us-east; 2 min before the change; record R017)
Changed checkout db.pool_size from 50 to 5 (all regions) (checkout; 1 min before the change; record R018)
p95 latency above SLO on checkout (checkout; 15 min after the change; record R020)
checkout: WARN connection pool exhausted, waiting for a free connection (checkout, ap-south; 10 min after the change; record R019)
checkout: WARN connection pool exhausted, waiting for a free connection (checkout, us-east; 27 min after the change; record R021)

reasons: ✓ A change event (deploys) lines up in time (2 min before the change).
✓ 3 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✗ 1 other change event(s) fit about as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.
✗ Two or more changes fit equally well, so the cause cannot be confirmed.
missing_data: Details to tell the competing changes apart (e.g. a rollback test)

actions.action: Rollback the deployment of checkout v2.26 to us-east.
Increase the db.pool_size back to 50 for all regions.
Monitor the connection pool and adjust as needed to prevent exhaustion.
